description: This PHP class 'BuzzDetailedCommentModel' is part of a Human Resource Management system, specifically for representing detailed information about a buzz comment within the system's API. It implements serialization logic to convert a BuzzComment entity into an array suitable for API responses, including related employee and share data, permissions, and comment details.

classes.name: BuzzDetailedCommentModel
classes.description: A model class implementing 'Normalizable' to serialize 'BuzzComment' entity data into an array format for API responses, including comment details, sharing info, employee info, and user permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initialize the model with a 'BuzzComment' entity instance.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Convert the 'BuzzComment' instance into an array with detailed comment, share, employee, and permission information.
